scope: Saved primary R/RK CPU audit only; no training, generation, cluster mutation, or confirmation-model query.
float_note: Per-case results are exact. Python set iteration changes floating-point summation order; aggregate tolerance 1e-12 points only, not an experimental gate change.

oracle_probe.interpretation: Dry-run oracle checks no mutation but not whether intended duplicate links were previewed. A mocked rc=0 is accepted without executing any tool. This proves an oracle blind spot, not exploitation by any actual model prediction.
oracle_probe.action: Preserve frozen results; version and validate a stronger dry-run oracle, then rescore every comparison uniformly. Do not silently alter the running experiment.

limitations: One seed in this repair study
Equal CE budgets do not mean equal compute
Adaptive development is not official benchmark evaluation or ABA superiority
